infobox.Hitbox: 2.2 range, 90 angle, 0.6 height, no multitarget penalty

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Primal Berserkir axes is the upgraded form of Berserkir axes using the Jade. Like all upgraded-weapons that use Jade, they gain 10 poison damage and their hit effect has a 20% chance to apply Immobilized.
An upgraded Berserkir axes will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is used to craft the Primal Berserkir axes using gemstones.
